name: @hl-bos/hscs-website
description: HSCS marketing website — Herman Supply Chain Solutions, Transportation & Operations Consulting. The public marketing site implementing the approved HSCS Commercial Launch Phase 1 Baseline (Commercial Foundation, Website IA, Homepage Architecture, Homepage Copy, Page Specifications, Design System). Milestone 2A delivers the application foundation, the Design System tokens in code, the shared header/nav/footer, and the homepage only. It has NO backend: no assessment intake, no Supabase, no email, no analytics. The primary CTA links to an honest 'being prepared' page rather than a fake form.
